This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

As the Southern Provincial Council has been dissolved ,the powers vested upon the Minister in charge of the subject of Co-operatives of the Southern Province by section 2(4) of Co-operative Societies Act, No. 05 of 1972, as amended by Acts No. 32 of 1983 and No. 11 of 1992 as per Provincial Councils (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989, have been assigned to me by article 154 (C) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and in terms of the such powers I, Lakshman Yapa Abewardhana, the Governor of the Southern Province hereby assigned all powers depicted in column III of the said schedule, assigned to the Registrar of Co-operative Societies under Co-operative Societies Act, No. 05 of 1972 as amended by Act No. 32 of 1983 and Act, No. 11 of 1992 and the regulations enacted there under to the person mentioned in the column I of the following schedule and who has been appointed to assist the Commissioner of Co-operative Development and the Registrar of Co-operative Societies of Southern Province from the date mentioned in the column II of the said schedule.
Lakshman Yapa Abewardhana, Governor of Southern Province.
